# Synthetic site fixtures

These files are **made up for tests**. They imitate the structure of a Shopify store
(product JSON in cents, a quantity-break block, an FAQ accordion, `.shopify-policy__body`,
a header/footer, an announcement bar, a newsletter popup and crossed-out compare-at prices),
so the parser can be tested without network access.

They are NOT copies of avora-il.com - that site could not be reached from the build
environment. The wording of the policies here is placeholder text and must never be used
as a source of facts.
